mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS exceeds 200.0, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand strength, which signals improving corporate revenue visibility and reduced recession risk, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS rise, SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 for two consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which increases the risk of a near-term economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO remains below 100.0 for two months, SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts or initiate tightening, which increases real discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% yoy, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both GDP growth (GDPC1) and residential investment (HOUST) indicates a broad-based demand contraction, which increases the likelihood of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% combined with stagnant payroll growth (PAYEMS < 100k) signals labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS < 100.0, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the joint signal fails to produce a Rank IC above 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 for three consecutive months, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), indicates a supply-side shock coupled with labor market stress, which increases uncertainty and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100.0 for 3 consecutive months AND UNRATE > 4.8
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100.0 for 3 months and UNRATE > 4.8, SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.
